words.example: A big letter starts a name.
I can read the bus sign.
The bus is at the stop.
Letters are in our daily life.

lessons.title: Letters around us
lessons.en:
Anna: Look! There are letters on the sign.
Ben: Yes! I can see a big letter B and a small letter s.
Anna: This is the bus sign. B-U-S, bus!
Ben: Letters are everywhere in our life.
Anna: Let's find more letters on the way to school.
lessons.cn:
安娜：看！招牌上有字母。
本：是的！我看到一个大写字母 B 和一个小写字母 s。
安娜：这是公交车标志。B-U-S，bus！
本：字母在我们生活中无处不在。
安娜：我们去上学的路上再找找更多字母吧。

lessons.title: The ABC song
lessons.en:
We have 26 letters in the alphabet.
Some letters are big, and some are small.
We see them on signs, on a bus, and in books.
We use letters to write our names.
Letters help us read the world. How nice!
lessons.cn:
字母表里有 26 个字母。
有些字母是大写的，有些是小写的。
我们在招牌上、公交车上、书里看到它们。
我们用字母写自己的名字。
字母帮助我们读懂世界。多棒呀！
